summary: Fix the aria-valuenow zero-value bug: introduce a splitVal variable to track current split position instead of reading from the DOM attribute (parseInt('0',10)||50 would incorrectly return 50 when at position 0). Update setSplit to maintain splitVal and use it in the keydown handler.

replacements.search:
let raf = 0;
  const setSplit = (v) => cmp.style.setProperty("--split", `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, v))}%`);
